component.name: MC Mod Project Manager
component.summary: Manage Minecraft mod projects and versions

description.p: Desktop tool for Minecraft mod projects in master/Minecraft version/project: git worktrees with one shared repository per mod, changelogs drafted by Claude Code and a cleanup of the Gradle caches.
git, Gradle, Claude Code and IntelliJ IDEA are the ones installed on the system – the app starts them outside its sandbox.
